microarray.readouts: gene expression levels, differentially expressed genes

evidence_location.quote: Comparing two days after vaccination to baseline, 1100 genes were differentially expressed (false discovery rate <0.05).

ex-vivo IFN-γ ELISpot.readouts: antigen 85A-specific IFN-γ spot-forming cells, immunogenicity/AUC responses

evidence_location.quote: responders based on an area under the curve analysis for IFN-γ ELISpot responses to 66 overlapping peptides covering antigen 85A

flow cytometry.readouts: frequency of CD4+ CD25+ Foxp3+ Tregs; TLR1 surface expression/mean fluorescence intensity

evidence_location.quote: In high responders, the number of Tregs (as a percentage of CD4+ cells) remained constant pre- and post vaccination, however in low responders it increased between day 0 and day 7 (Figure 2a, p = 0.009).

qPCR.readouts: expression of selected genes including TLR1, CD14, TICAM2, CTLA4, IL2RA, CXCL2

evidence_location.quote: We measured the expression of the nine genes by qPCR and again classified the volunteers as high or low responders based on the median AUC value for their ELISpot responses.

qPCR.obi_label: real time polymerase chain reaction assay

western blot.sample_type: cell culture supernatant from infected/stimulated cells

evidence_location.quote: HMGB1 is detectable by western blot in the supernatant of infected cells 4 and 6 hours post infection but not in the supernatant of uninfected cells after 6 hours.
